title: ItemDeltaPayload
description:
Payload of the `events/item_delta` notification.

# Examples

``` use std::sync::Arc; use zhive_proto::domain::{ThreadId, TurnId}; use zhive_proto::events::ItemDeltaPayload; let p = ItemDeltaPayload::new( ThreadId(Arc::from("thread:native/t")), TurnId(Arc::from("turn:thread:native/t/0")), "Hello".into(), ); let v = serde_json::to_value(&p).unwrap(); assert_eq!(v["delta"], "Hello"); let back: ItemDeltaPayload = serde_json::from_value(v).unwrap(); assert_eq!(back, p); ```
